name: PHIL 5484
title: Proposal, Prospectus, and Dissertation Writing Seminar
description: Philosophy students will write and circulate drafts and get feedback on their proposal, prospectus, or dissertation, and practice the presentation of their work. Students working on philosophical theory outside the department are also welcome. May be repeated for a total of 12 credits.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in Philosophy; others by instructor consent.
